subject: Music Production
title: Brian Eno's Ambient Experiments
description: A 60-second lesson on Brian Eno's Ambient Experiments.

hook.text: Brian Eno lay in bed recovering from an accident when quiet music played from a broken speaker.

buildup.text: The volume was so low that the music blended with rain outside, creating an atmospheric texture.

discovery.text: Eno realized music could be an environment rather than a performance, and invented ambient music.

twist.text: He also created Oblique Strategies, random prompt cards that producers still use to spark ideas.

climax.text: Eno produced U2 and Talking Heads, bringing ambient ideas into mainstream rock albums.

punchline.text: A broken speaker inspired an entire music genre.

quiz.question: What inspired Brian Eno to create ambient music?
options: Hearing quiet music from a broken speaker while recovering
